ammonia.reason: Low ureolysis/proteolysis deamination with no surface flora, only slight NH3 release after 6 mo.

animal_barnyard.reason: Lamb rennet paste lipolysis gives faint animal note but no p-cresol/indole accumulation.

bitter.reason: Moderate hydrophobic peptides from chymosin/pepsin in lamb rennet and plasmin proteolysis.

blue_moldy.reason: No Penicillium roqueforti; 2-heptanone/2-nonanone not detected, no methyl ketone pathway.

browning.reason: Good Maillard: residual galactose + lysine, pH ~5.0-5.5 and 41% moisture allow browning on heating.

buttery.reason: Very low acetoin 3.8-62 ug/kg and no diacetyl due to thermophilic starter and hot-stretch loss.

cheesy_sweaty.reason: High free butanoic 782 mg/kg + hexanoic 308 mg/kg from lamb pregastric lipase lipolysis.

creaminess.reason: 26.6% fat emulsified in aligned paracasein fibers from pasta-filata stretching gives smooth mouthfeel.

crumbliness.reason: Plasticized stretched curd forms fibrous cohesive matrix, not short acid-crumbly body.

firmness.reason: Semi-hard 41% moisture, brine-salted and 4-mo dried rind, calcium-paracasein network firm.

floral_honey.reason: Phenylacetaldehyde/2-phenylethanol not quantified; only trace yeast phenylalanine catabolism.

fruity.reason: Low esters ethyl hexanoate 35-123 ug/kg + butyl butanoate from esterase esterification of FFA.

goaty.reason: Cow milk, no goat 4-methyloctanoic/4-ethyloctanoic acids despite caproic/caprylic lipolysis.

malty_nutty.reason: Moderate Strecker/proteolysis aldehydes and amino-acid catabolism during 3-6 mo ripening.

melt.reason: De-mineralized pH ~5.1 stretched paracasein flows readily on heating, not acid-set non-melter.

mushroom_earthy.reason: 1-octen-3-ol/1-octen-3-one not found; no surface mold lipoxygenase pathway.

oil_off.reason: 26.6% fat with coalesced pools from hot stretching releases moderate free oil when melted.

smoky.reason: Typical unsmoked make; no wood-smoke guaiacol/phenols unless affumicata variant.

sour_vinegar.reason: Acetic 18-2503 ug/kg + propionic from thermophilic lactobacilli/streptococci fermentation, pH 5.0-5.5.

stretch.reason: Classic pasta-filata: hot-water plasticization aligns casein for strong fibrous stretch.

sulfur_cooked.reason: Hot stretch volatilizes methanethiol/DMS; no cooked-milk H2S from high-heat treatment.

sweet.reason: Lactose depleted by starter; slight sweetness from free amino acids and low salt masking.

umami.reason: Accumulating glutamate from chymosin/plasmin + bacterial peptidase proteolysis with age.
